items.quote: As recently as 2022, I had a severe fear of being on camera.
items.statement: The author once had a severe fear of being on camera as recently as 2022.

items.quote: I knew that if I wanted to grow my business, I had to overcome it. And I did.
items.statement: The author overcame their fear of being on camera to grow their business.

items.quote: Because your first videos don’t need to be good. They just need to exist.
items.statement: First videos don’t need to be good, they just need to exist.

items.quote: Today, filming yourself is a mandatory part of my coaching programme for agents too.
items.statement: Filming oneself is a mandatory part of the author's coaching program for agents.

items.quote: Mine were painfully cringe. If you don’t believe me, go to my YouTube channel and find my first videos. Cringe is still there.
items.statement: The author's early videos were 'painfully cringe,' and they encourage viewers to see them for themselves.

overview: Instagram post discussing overcoming fear of speaking on camera for business growth.
